propositions: A reconcile pass over an empty store proves nothing; the suite must run against a real store copy with realistic volume, ticket shapes, and link graphs to surface field-mapping and ordering defects.

Isolation requires a separate repo with no git remote (primary), REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off (secondary), no Cloud credentials in the environment, and no binding artifacts—each layer independent and all asserted by test.
The store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* artifacts and production Jira bindings to prevent outbound mutations from writing to real issues.

Bidirectional round-trip mutations (28 cells × 2 directions = 56 oracle assertions) must be individually verified through independent reads of the remote state, not by aggregate pass-convergence metrics.
Pagination is a remote property; the suite must seed 2×observed_page_size+1 issues in the harness and verify all are recovered inbound, independent of the local store copy.
